snippet.title: Our Town Hero: A Cozy Retro RPG - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Gameplay trailer for Our Town Hero: A Cozy Retro RPG.

Watch the seasons change as you restore a small town to it's former glory & rescue those who have been kidnapped by an ancient vampire.

Check it out on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3752630/Our_Town_Hero/

Music:
Magnificent Quest Music by Joel Steudler
